items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Yeah, and this little fellow named Memphis.

ctx.x: And he did a lot of clowning and everything in the old days.

Yeah, and this little fellow named Memphis. Memphis. And they had a little, you know, a little guy named Memphis. I heard some people say he wouldn't, but I heard he was from here. He wrote some more. Yeah, he got ice cream names, just like him.
